title: Universal property of the finite-adele shear pushout

A_bounded_localization_universality.statement: For each checked bounded denominator stage Z[1/L], a map from Z into a Q-vector kernel extends uniquely by Q-linearity; this is the finite certificate for the Z -> Q localization used in C_Z -> C_Q.

B_finite_Hausdorff_shadows.statement: The pushout does not create ordinary finite cokernels: integer residues already cover every checked finite quotient.

C_factorization_through_C_Q.statement: For checked finite-dimensional Q-vector kernels, fixing the image of 1 gives a unique factorization through Q, hence through the pushed-out complex C_Q.

D_torsion_divisible_caveat.statement: If 'divisible kernel' is read literally and torsion is allowed, uniqueness fails.  The maps q |-> kq mod Z from Q to Q/Z all vanish on Z, but differ on fractions.

conclusion.valid_universal_property: C_Q is initial for shear-preserving quotient models with uniquely divisible/Q-vector kernels, or equivalently for models equipped with a specified Q-linear kernel map.
conclusion.invalid_naive_version: The same statement is false for arbitrary divisible kernels because torsion-divisible summands such as Q/Z destroy uniqueness.
conclusion.next_task: Upgrade the finite certificate to a mapping-space statement in D(Solid), explicitly excluding or decorating torsion divisible summands.
